changelog:
- Initial release of the scale-scorer tool.
- Automatically detects dimensions in scale/questionnaire data using prefix+number column naming.
- Calculates average scores per dimension, supporting reverse scoring and missing value handling.
- Accepts Excel (.xlsx) and CSV input; outputs results as a structured file with new dimension columns.
- Command-line usage with options for reverse scoring and custom score range.
summary: 自动识别量表维度（前缀+数字命名），计算各维度均分，支持反向计分和缺失处理。输入支持 Excel (.xlsx) 和 CSV
